## Added

- Added a Windows Setup installer. Setup installs for all users and downloads the Microsoft .NET 10 Desktop Runtime only when it is missing or when repair is selected.
- Added separate panel positions and sizes for single-monitor and multi-monitor setups. Layouts are restored automatically when a monitor is connected, disconnected, or switched off with its own button.
- Added a Single monitor / Multiple monitors toggle in panel settings, with its own width and height for each setup.
- Added a "Move to desktop" action to the icon menu.
- Added a rainbow accent bar to the management window.

## Changes

- Changed automatic updates to use the Setup package for installations made with Setup, and removed the separate package that required .NET 10.
- Changed shortcuts added to a panel from the desktop to be moved to the Recycle Bin.
- Improved live wallpapers on multi-monitor and scaled displays with DPI-aware bounds, redrawing after display changes, and WebView2 data kept in the application data folder.
- Improved startup diagnostics with a startup log.
- Improved the add-to-panel confirmation by making the window shorter.
- Renamed the layouts button in the Panels tab to "Zarządzaj układami".

## Fixed

- Fixed panels overlapping or losing their position when a monitor is turned off or disconnected.
- Fixed a still wallpaper not replacing a previously saved live wallpaper at the next start.

## Download

Windows x64 Setup EXE (recommended), or a single EXE with .NET 10 included for portable use.
